input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having trouble sending those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called? It’s been a few hours now and I just can’t get them to go through. Can you help me fix this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough—do you need anything else from me?

I’m not sure about browsing the web or using apps, but I do see a little “5G” symbol at the top of my phone, and the signal bars look full. There’s also something that looks like a circle with a line through it—does that mean something is off? I haven’t tried making calls or sending regular texts just now. Should I check those?

At the top of my phone, I see the signal bars are full, there’s a “5G” symbol, and that circle with a line through it. My battery is about 80%. I don’t see the little Wi-Fi symbol, just those.

I haven’t tried making a call or sending a regular text yet—should I do that now? And does that circle mean my data is off or something? I get confused by all these symbols.

I just checked, and I don’t see an airplane icon—so I guess Airplane Mode is off. My signal is excellent and it says 5G, but it looks like my mobile data is turned off. I’m not connected to Wi-Fi either.

Should I try turning the mobile data on? And do you still want me to try making a call and sending a regular text, or should I do something else first?

Okay, I turned my mobile data on and I see a new symbol at the top now—it looks like a little phone with some lines next to it. I tried sending a picture message again, but it still won’t go through.

What should I do next? This is getting a bit frustrating.

I looked at the APN settings, but honestly, I don’t really understand what I’m seeing. I’m not very comfortable changing these things on my own.

I’ve reset the APN settings like you said, but it says the changes will only take effect after I restart my phone. I get a bit nervous about restarting—will I lose any of my photos or messages if I do that? I really don’t want to lose anything important.
Alright, I restarted my phone like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. It’s really starting to worry me—why isn’t this working? Is there anything else we can try?
I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is already turned off on my phone. What should I try next? I really hope we can get this fixed soon.
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it already has access to storage, SMS, and phone. Is there anything else that could be causing this? I’m still not able to send picture messages.

Oh, I see! That explains it. I’d like to add 2GB of data, please, but I don’t want to change my plan—just the extra data for now. Can you confirm the total price before you go ahead? I just want to make sure I understand.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2GB of data for $4.00. I’d really like to be able to send picture messages again. Thank you for explaining everything so clearly!

I just tried sending a picture message again, but it still won’t go through. Do I need to restart my phone now that I have the extra data? I’m a bit nervous about doing that again—are you sure it’s safe?
I restarted my phone like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. Is there anything else we can try? I’m starting to get a bit worried that something’s really wrong.
I tried running a speed test, but it says there’s no connection. Does that mean my mobile data still isn’t working, even though I added more? What should I do now?

My mobile data is still turned on, and I see the 5G and data symbols at the top. I’m a bit nervous about removing the SIM card—could you walk me through toggling Airplane Mode first? I’d rather try that before messing with the SIM.

I turned Airplane Mode on and off like you said, but when I tried the speed test again, it still says there’s no connection. What should I do now? I’m really not sure about taking out the SIM card on my own—could you explain that part slowly if we need to try it?

I followed your instructions and reseated the SIM card, but after turning my phone back on, the speed test still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to feel a bit overwhelmed—what else can we try?
